header.clearConfirmedConfirm: Unconfirm the transactions shown? Their receipts and memos are kept.
header.clearAutoMatchConfirm: Clear the automatic matches of the transactions shown? Their receipts go back to the unmatched list; manual matches and confirmed transactions are kept.
header.clearAutoMemoConfirm: Clear the automatic memos of the transactions shown? Memos written by hand are kept.
header.clearMonthConfirm: Delete the {{count}} transactions shown for {{month}}? Their receipts go back to the unmatched list. This cannot be undone.

export.title: Export
export.intro: The {{count}} transactions of {{scope}} for {{month}} will be exported, with their memos.

formats.xlsxDesc: An Excel workbook (.xlsx); dates and amounts stay dates and numbers.
formats.csvDesc: UTF-8 text with a BOM: Excel opens it as it is, and so does anything else.

autoMatch.title: Auto match
autoMatch.intro: The transactions shown will be paired with recognized, unmatched receipts by these rules:

rules.amountDesc: The receipt's amount equals the transaction's, or differs from it by a transfer fee.
rules.dateDesc: The closer the dates, the surer the match; a receipt far off in date is matched only on an exact amount.
rules.name: Similar names
rules.nameDesc: A payee on the receipt that resembles the transaction's description makes the match surer.

autoMatch.note: Each receipt is matched to one transaction at most; a transaction can take several receipts (a transfer slip and its invoice, say), unless it has been confirmed. Matches carry a confidence and can be undone with Clear → Clear auto matches.

autoMemo.title: Auto memo
autoMemo.intro: The following memos will be added automatically:
autoMemo.promptHint: Each account has a prompt of its own. Left empty, the default prompt is used.
autoMemo.promptDefault: You are a bookkeeping assistant. From the account details and each row's date, description and amount, write a short memo per row saying what it is for or who the counterparty is. When reference material is given, follow the memos it has for the same or similar descriptions. Leave a memo empty when you cannot tell.
autoMemo.referenceHint: An Excel or CSV file, such as past transactions with their memos written.
autoMemo.referenceType: The reference material must be a CSV or Excel file

rules.transferDesc: A transfer between two of the accounts on the same day is marked with the other account's name.
rules.aiDesc: The account and each row's description and amount go to the AI, which decides what to write on the rows that have no memo; past material can be attached for it to follow.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore the backup from {{time}}? The current data will be overwritten. This cannot be undone.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup from {{time}}? This cannot be undone.
